title: LifeHeartsPro
description: A Life plugin with teams, PlaceholderAPI support and configurable lives system.
body:
# ❤️ LifeHeartsPro ❤️

LifeHeartsPro is a powerful and highly configurable **life & hearts management plugin** designed for Minecraft servers that want more than just a simple life system.

This plugin combines **heart mechanics, a custom team system, revive commands, and deep configuration options** to create a balanced and engaging gameplay experience.

Whether you're running a **SMP, event server, or competitive survival world**, LifeHeartsPro gives you the flexibility and tools needed to control how players interact, cooperate, and survive.

---

## ❤️ Advanced Life & Heart System

LifeHeartsPro introduces a clean and flexible **life-based gameplay system** where hearts play a central role.

Players can interact with the heart system in meaningful ways, creating **strategic gameplay and stronger player interactions**.

The plugin focuses on **balance, fairness, and server control**, allowing administrators to configure exactly how the system behaves.

---

## 🔁 Heart Transfers Between Players

Players can **transfer hearts to other players**, allowing cooperation and strategic decisions.

This mechanic encourages:

- Team support  
- Player alliances  
- Strategic survival decisions  

Servers can fully configure how heart transfers behave to maintain balance.

Example command:


/heart give <player> <amount>


---

## 👥 Advanced Team System

LifeHeartsPro includes its own **advanced team system** that allows players to create and manage teams directly in-game.

### Team Features

- Create your own teams
- Invite players
- Kick players
- Leave teams
- Disband teams
- Friendly fire protection

### Team Commands

/team create <name>
/team invite <player>
/team accept
/team kick <player>
/team leave
/team disband


This makes team gameplay **smooth, balanced and easy to manage**.

---

## 🔄 Admin Revive System

Admins can **revive eliminated players** and bring them back into the game.

Example command:

/lifehearts revive <player>


This is useful for:

- Events
- Hardcore servers
- Community competitions
- Special gameplay situations

---

## ⚙️ Highly Configurable

LifeHeartsPro was designed with **maximum customization** in mind.

Server owners can easily adjust gameplay through the configuration files.

You can configure things like:

- Default lives
- Heart mechanics
- Friendly fire
- Team behavior
- Notifications
- Actionbar display
- Plugin behavior

Everything is designed to be **simple but powerful**.

---

## 📊 PlaceholderAPI Support

LifeHeartsPro supports **PlaceholderAPI**, allowing you to integrate plugin data into other plugins.

You can use placeholders in:

- Scoreboards
- Chat formats
- Tab lists
- Holograms
- Other plugins

Example placeholder:

%lifehearts_lives%


---

## 📢 Custom ActionBar System

The plugin includes a **custom ActionBar system** that shows important information to players.

Example display:

❤ Lives | Team


This allows players to always see their important status information without filling the chat.

---

## 📜 Commands

### LifeHearts Admin Commands

/lifehearts reload
/lifehearts revive <player>
/lifehearts set <player> <lives>
/lifehearts add <player> <lives>
/lifehearts remove <player> <lives>


---

## 🔐 Permissions

LifeHeartsPro supports permission plugins like **LuckPerms**, **PermissionsEx**, and others.

### Admin Permissions

lifehearts.admin


Allows:

- Reviving players
- Reloading the plugin
- Changing player lives
  

---

## 🎮 Perfect For

LifeHeartsPro works perfectly for:

- SMP servers
- Hardcore servers
- Event servers
- Competitive survival worlds
- Community servers

---

## 🚀 Performance & Stability

LifeHeartsPro is designed to run **efficiently and reliably**, even on busy servers.

The plugin focuses on:

- Stability
- Clean mechanics
- Smooth gameplay

This ensures the **heart and team systems run without affecting server performance**.

---

## ❤️ Take Control of Your Server's Life System

If you want a **modern life system combined with team gameplay and deep configuration**, LifeHeartsPro is the perfect choice.

Take control of your server's life system with **LifeHeartsPro** ❤️
